title: DataCompliance
description: ISO 25012-sourced data quality archetype — Compliance inherent-and-system data quality characteristic. The degree to which data has attributes that adhere to standards, conventions, or regulations in force and similar rules relating to data quality in a specific context of use. Rootless archetype — used as qualifier in Directives/Norms governing data entities. Source: ISO/IEC 25012 (Inherent and System-Dependent Data Quality — Compliance).

complianceLevel.description: Degree of compliance with applicable data standards/regulations.

applicableStandards.description: List of standards, regulations, or conventions the data must comply with (e.g., GDPR, ISO 8601, industry codes).

auditTrailRequired.description: Whether an audit trail of data changes is required for compliance.
